description: What an employer's own job ads say about its hiring process: the steps they name (interview, test, case task and so on), the median number of interviews, how often it re-posts roles, its applicant tracking system and how often it states pay. Takes a companyId from a search result. Employers with fewer than 5 ads return no process. Reuse: figures may be quoted with a visible link to the jobcrawls.com page in the result (or "JobCrawls (jobcrawls.com)" where a link is impossible); each result repeats this in dataUse.

companyId.description: The companyId from a search result or a company card. Not a display name.

dataUse.description: What may be reused from this result and how to credit JobCrawls.

limitReached.description: Present when a weekly limit stopped the call: which limit, its size and when it resets.
